thesis.author: Abbie L. Donaldson
thesis.title: Characterisation of Jupiter-family comet nuclei by time-series photometry

thermalSize.credit: Fernández et al. (2013), SEPPCoN; values retained in Donaldson (2025)

meshAvailability: No public original mesh found in the thesis record or its conference abstract. The 162P paper makes the shape available on request. This package uses published numeric constraints only.
coordinateDiscrepancy: Thesis Table 5.2 prints RA 188 degrees for Model 1, inconsistent with its ecliptic pole in section 4.3.1.1, Figure 4.29 and Tables 4.3/4.5. This package converts the repeatedly reported ecliptic pole (132.5, -56.5) directly, yielding RA 117.873 and Dec -37.100 degrees.
